name: Cyberpunk Neon
description: High-tech, low-life night scenes: near-black bases, saturated magenta/cyan/violet light, controlled glow on hero edges, atmospheric haze and dense signage-like detail.
visual_characteristics: dark base (near-black indigo) with strong colour contrast between a magenta/pink key and a cyan/teal fill light
neon strokes with a glow: bright core line + wider translucent halo
atmosphere: volumetric haze, rain streaks, light shafts, reflections on wet ground
dense layered city/tech detail: signs, wires, HUD marks, katakana-like glyphs (as shapes)

palette.guidance: Base #06050f-#120a26. Key neon magenta (#ff2a6d), electric cyan (#05d9e8), violet (#7b2ff7), acid accent (#f9f871 or #ffb300) used sparingly. Colour temperature contrast between lights. Keep 70% dark / 25% mid / 5% pure neon.

geometry: Hard-edged, angular architecture with vertical emphasis; skewed and perspective-flavoured slabs; thin precise strokes; occasional circles for signs and moons. Silhouettes first, neon rims second.
stroke: Hero strokes 2-6 units with round caps; each has a paired halo (same path, wider, lower opacity, blurred or stepped). Secondary detail in hairline 0.5-1.
texture: Scanlines (repeated thin lines at 5-10% opacity), light grain, rain streaks, subtle chromatic offset by duplicating a shape in cyan/magenta with small x-shift.
composition: Strong vanishing point or vertical canyon of buildings; subject silhouetted against a glowing backdrop (sun/sign/moon); foreground dark, mid lit by neon, background haze-lit. Diagonals and leading lines.
typography: Condensed sans or monospace, wide tracking, neon-outlined; vertical signs; faux-katakana built from strokes. Keep <=2 short text elements.
lighting_depth: Rim lighting and colour-cast: magenta from one side, cyan from the other. Glow = additive feel via lighter stroke core over a saturated halo. Haze gradients increase toward the horizon.
svg_techniques: define 2 reusable filters: #glow-soft (feGaussianBlur stdDeviation 3-6 merged with SourceGraphic) and #glow-hard (stdDev 1-2); set filter region x/y/width/height to -30%/160% so glows are not clipped
apply filters to GROUPS of neon strokes, not each path
sky/haze via linearGradient stops (deep indigo -> magenta at horizon) and radialGradient for moon/sun glow
wet-ground reflection: <use> the skyline flipped (scale(1,-1)) with a gradient mask fading to transparent
scanlines/rain as a single <pattern> overlay at low opacity
avoid: a single flat neon colour without a complementary fill light
filters on hundreds of small shapes

name: Y2K
description: Optimistic techno-future as imagined around 1999-2004: liquid chrome, translucent plastic, bubble shapes, metallic gradients, sparkles, tribal/atomic motifs and saturated candy colours.
visual_characteristics: liquid chrome and glossy plastic forms with strong specular highlights
rounded pill/bubble shapes, lens flares and 4-point sparkle stars
iridescent / holographic gradient washes (blue-violet-pink-cyan)
cyber-tribal swooshes, atomic orbits, pixel/cursor/UI fragments as motifs

palette.guidance: Silver/chrome greys with candy accents: aqua, electric blue, hot pink, lime, violet; iridescent gradients across pink-cyan-lavender. White highlights are crisp.

geometry: Rounded, inflated forms (superellipses, pills, blobs), sharp-tipped stars and swooshes, concentric ring motifs. Consistent glossy 'top light' highlight shapes.
stroke: Mostly no strokes; thin white inner strokes or 1-2 unit dark-blue outlines on chrome for edge definition; swooshes as tapered filled paths.
texture: Gloss highlights, faint dot-matrix or grid backgrounds, sparkle overlays; optional subtle halftone.
composition: Centred hero object floating on a bright gradient field; orbiting rings and sparkles; symmetrical or dynamic diagonal; UI-window or CD-disc motifs as framing.
typography: Rounded or extended sans, chrome gradient fill with dark outline and highlight, italics; Bank-Gothic-like caps.
lighting_depth: Glossy: bright specular streak along the top, dark reflection band near the bottom (chrome horizon line), soft rim of light. Depth via layered translucent shapes.
svg_techniques: chrome via linearGradient with 6-8 stops that alternate light/dark (a fake horizon reflection)
gloss highlight = a clipped ellipse/path with a white->transparent linearGradient
iridescence via a multi-stop conic-like wash: layer 2-3 low-opacity linear gradients at different angles
sparkles = 4-point star <path> defined once, <use> at various sizes

name: Frutiger Aero
description: Mid-2000s techno-optimism: glossy translucent UI surfaces set against bright skies, water, bubbles, fresh grass and dolphins-and-orbs imagery; clean, luminous, friendly.
visual_characteristics: sky-blue to white gradient fields with soft clouds and lens flares
glass and aqua buttons, bubbles, droplets with bright caustic highlights
nature + tech pairing: leaves, water, sunbeams next to glossy UI shapes
high key, airy, luminous - everything looks freshly rinsed

palette.guidance: Aqua/sky blues, fresh leaf greens, white highlights; small warm accents (sun yellow, orange). High-key, saturated but clean. Transparent whites for glass.

geometry: Soft rounded rectangles, perfect spheres, teardrops; smooth flowing swooshes; subtle perspective floor plane. Everything is inflated and smooth.
stroke: Nearly none; edge defined by a thin semi-transparent white inner border and a soft darker rim gradient.
texture: Smooth. Optional subtle noise-free bokeh circles and water caustic streaks.
composition: Wide open sky, horizon low; hero glossy object/UI panel centred-left; bubbles and light rays fanning from a corner; foreground grass/water strip for grounding.
typography: Humanist sans (Frutiger/Segoe-like), title with soft white shadow; light weights; sentence case.
lighting_depth: Bright ambient with a strong sun flare; glass objects with top specular arc and bottom bounce light; soft blurred shadows on the ground plane.
svg_techniques: bubble = radialGradient (transparent centre -> pale-blue edge) + crescent highlight path + tiny secondary highlight
glossy button = rounded rect with vertical linearGradient + clipped upper-half highlight with white 60%->10% gradient
lens flare = layered low-opacity circles and a thin cross-star; single radialGradient for the sun glow
one soft blur filter only for ground shadows

name: Glassmorphism
description: Frosted translucent panels floating above vivid blurred colour fields; thin bright borders, soft shadows and subtle inner light convey glass depth.
visual_characteristics: vibrant blurred gradient blobs as the backdrop
translucent white/tinted panels with a 1px light border and soft inner glow
layered depth: panel over panel, each blurring what is behind
high polish, soft shadows, generous corner radii

palette.guidance: Rich, saturated background blobs (violet, blue, pink, teal) on a deep or bright field; glass in white at 10-25% opacity, borders white at 30-50%. Text/icon in near-white or deep navy for contrast.

geometry: Rounded rectangles (radius 5-8% of the panel), circles, soft blobs. Panels overlap at slight angles or offsets; consistent radius system.
stroke: 1-1.5 unit border with a linearGradient stroke (white 60% top-left -> transparent bottom-right) to fake edge light.
texture: Optional very faint noise; otherwise clean.
composition: 2-3 glass panels layered over 2-4 colour blobs; hero panel holds the icon or content; off-centre arrangement with clear hierarchy; large soft shadow under the topmost panel.
typography: Clean geometric sans, medium/semibold, white or navy; small labels at 60-70% opacity.
lighting_depth: Fake backdrop blur: draw a blurred copy of the background shapes clipped to each panel; add inner top-left highlight, soft drop shadow beneath.
svg_techniques: SVG has no backdrop-filter: for each panel <use> the background group with a feGaussianBlur filter (stdDeviation ~12) and clip-path = the panel shape, then overlay a translucent white fill
gradient stroke (userSpaceOnUse) for the light border
inner glow by a stroke-only duplicate clipped inside the panel with blur
reuse one blur filter id for all panels; define the background as <g id="bg"> in defs
avoid: blur on the whole canvas (kills legibility)

name: Clay / Soft 3D
description: Chunky, rounded, pillowy forms that look like sculpted clay or matte vinyl: soft gradients, inner shadows and highlights, gentle ambient occlusion and pastel palettes.
visual_characteristics: everything is inflated; no sharp corners, thick rounded volumes
matte shading with soft top-left highlight and inner bottom-right shadow
pastel or mid-saturation palette; colour bleed in shadows
soft contact shadows anchoring objects on a plain or gently graded ground

palette.guidance: Soft mid-saturation hues (peach, lilac, mint, butter, sky) on a warm neutral ground; shadows are a darker, hue-shifted version of the object colour, never grey or black.

geometry: Spheres, capsules, rounded boxes, torus shapes with generous radii. Simplify anatomy into blobby primitives; slight squash-and-stretch for charm. Fillets everywhere.
stroke: None. Forms are defined by shading only.
texture: Very subtle fine grain optional at <=3%; otherwise perfectly smooth matte.
composition: Single hero object/character centred with 2-4 smaller floating props; consistent light direction; big soft shadow ellipse below; clean background.
typography: Chunky rounded sans built to feel inflated (heavy weight, round terminals); minimal use.
lighting_depth: Soft key light from top-left: broad highlight patch near the top-left; core shadow along bottom-right with bounce light on the far edge; contact shadow blurred.
svg_techniques: each volume = base fill + radialGradient (offset highlight centre at 30%/25%) + an inner-shadow crescent path clipped to the shape
rim/bounce light = thin lighter crescent along the shadow-side edge with low opacity
one shared blur filter for contact shadows; do not blur the forms themselves
build forms from <ellipse>/<rect rx> and clip highlights to them

name: Isometric
description: Parallel-projection pseudo-3D on a 30-degree grid: no vanishing point, three visible faces per block with consistent light values, tidy tiny-world dioramas.
visual_characteristics: true isometric axes (30 degrees from horizontal); vertical edges stay vertical
three face tones per object: top lightest, left mid, right darkest
objects sit on a diamond ground plane with crisp edges
small, dense, tidy scenes with repeated modular units

palette.guidance: Each material has a 3-tone face set (top / left / right) derived consistently; a soft base colour ground; 6-10 hues total; accents limited to props.

geometry: Author in 3D coordinates and project: x' = (x - y) * cos30, y' = (x + y) * sin30 - z. Build cubes from three parallelogram <polygon>s. Circles become ellipses with ratio ~1.73:1 (2:1 in pixel-iso).
stroke: Usually none; optional 1-unit darker edge lines on top edges only (consistent). Round joins.
texture: Flat faces; optional subtle pattern on floors (tiles) via a sheared <pattern>.
composition: Diamond-shaped vignette of the world centred in the canvas with air around; depth by draw order (back-to-front, low-to-high); a single large hero structure with smaller props.
typography: Rare; if used, text is projected with a skew transform to lie on a face.
lighting_depth: Fixed light from top-left: face tones stay constant; cast shadows are parallelograms projected at the same angle on the ground, opacity 0.15-0.25.
svg_techniques: write a tiny JS/Python generator or use helper symbols: define <symbol id="cube"> faces once and <use> with translate() for repeated blocks
use a matrix transform for flat art: matrix(0.866 0.5 -0.866 0.5 0 0) to lay flat shapes on the ground plane
sort draw order by (x+y+z) back-to-front
keep coordinates on a unit grid so edges meet exactly (avoid gaps by overlapping 0.2 units and using shape-rendering geometricPrecision)

name: Low Poly
description: Subjects and landscapes tessellated into flat-shaded triangles; the facets imply volume and light through value shifts while the outer silhouette stays clean and iconic.
visual_characteristics: triangulated mesh with denser vertices at complex/contour areas and larger triangles in flat areas
flat colour per facet, sampled from a gradient of the form (light -> shadow)
clean silhouette; facet edges invisible (no strokes) or hairline in same tone
subtle sparkle from a few brighter facets

palette.guidance: A 2-3 hue family per object with 6-10 value steps assigned per facet by facing direction to the light; background as a gentle gradient of the same family. Avoid random noise - value must follow form.

geometry: Triangles only (occasionally quads). Vertex placement guided by form: rings around volumes, ridge lines on landscapes. Triangle sizes vary 3-5x. Avoid slivers.
stroke: None. To hide anti-aliasing seams between facets add stroke of the same colour at 0.4-0.6 unit width (or shape-rendering="crispEdges" for large facets).
texture: None; the mesh is the texture.
composition: Strong central silhouette with mesh density highest at focal features (eyes, peaks); gradient background mesh that blends into the subject.
typography: Geometric sans, possibly also triangulated for a title; minimal.
lighting_depth: Single light direction: facet value from the dot product of facet normal and light; ridge highlights and core shadows on opposite sides.
svg_techniques: generate the mesh programmatically (Python/JS) from hand-placed anchor points + jittered Poisson-like fill, then colour each triangle from a value function; emit <polygon points>
use the same-colour hairline stroke (stroke-width .5, stroke-linejoin round) to close seams
group by object (id="body", "head", "bg") and sort by depth
quantise to ~12 distinct fills and define them as classes to keep the file small
avoid: visible dark wireframe (unless intentional wireframe variant)
